value.text:
The user wants me to act as Evidence Critic and check each claim against the cited evidence. I need to flag only factual problems: overstatements, wrong numbers/dates/suppliers, causes not stated, products/NDCs not in evidence. Reasonable conclusions from cited facts are supported.

Let me examine each claim:

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 16729-512-43 is on the FDA shortage list as 'Unavailable' with reason 'Requirements related to complying with good manufacturing practices' and no estimated recovery." Cited: [shortage-16729-512-43]

Evidence says: "FDA shortage list: Atropine Sulfate, Injection, .4 mg/1 mL (NDC 16729-512-43) from Accord Healthcare Inc.; availability: 'Unavailable'; FDA reason category: 'Requirements related to complying with good manufacturing practices'; estimated recovery: TBD; updated 10/03/2026"

Matches exactly. "TBD" means no estimated recovery. Supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "Current stock of 244 units provides 18 days of cover at 13.6 units per day." Cited: [stock-10]

Evidence says: "atropine sulfate ATROPINE SULFATE .4 mg/mL (Accord Healthcare Inc., NDC 16729-512-43, ANDA213424): 244 units on hand, 13.6/day over 30 days, 18 days of cover"

Matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 3: investigator: "No ongoing recall for this NDC." Cited: [search-recall-10]

Evidence says: "Searched this run's FDA ongoing-recall snapshot for our package NDC 16729-512-43 and product 16729-512: no ongoing recall."

Matches. Supported.

Claim 4: substitution: "Current atropine sulfate 0.4 mg/mL from Accord Healthcare has 18 days of cover." Cited: [stock-10]

Same as claim 2. Supported.

Claim 5: substitution: "Current product is therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) per Orange Book." Cited: [ob-ANDA213424-001]

Evidence says: "Orange Book: ATROPINE SULFATE 8MG/20ML (0.4MG/ML) ... by ACCORD HEALTHCARE INC, application ANDA213424, TE code AP (our current product)"

This indicates TE code AP. Supported.

Claim 6: substitution: "Substitute ANDA215005 is therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) to current product." Cited: [ob-ANDA215005-001, ob-ANDA213424-001]

Evidence: ob-ANDA215005-001 shows TE code AP for Somerset Therapeutics. ob-ANDA213424-001 shows TE code AP for Accord. Both have TE code AP, which means they are therapeutically equivalent to the reference listed drug, and thus to each other (since both are AP). The claim says "Substitute ANDA215005 is therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) to current product." This is supported by both having TE code AP. However, the evidence does not explicitly state they are equivalent to each other, but it's a reasonable conclusion that two products with TE code AP are therapeutically equivalent. The rules: "Reasonable conclusions that follow directly from the cited facts (for example 'an open order gives short-term cover') are supported." So this is supported.

Claim 7: substitution: "Substitute ANDA215005 has at least one package listed as Available on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [status-ANDA215005]

Evidence says: "Checked SOMERSET THERAPEUTICS LLC ANDA215005: 1 package(s) at our concentration in the FDA product listing (70069-481-10 by Somerset Therapeutics, LLC: FDA shortage list 'Available'); no ongoing recall on these products. Result: on the FDA shortage list, but at least one package at our concentration is listed as Available."

This matches. Supported.

Claim 8: substitution: "SOMERSET THERAPEUTICS LLC ANDA215005: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) per ob-ANDA215005-001 and ob-ANDA213424-001; at least one package Available per status-ANDA215005." Cited: [status-ANDA215005, ob-ANDA215005-001, ob-ANDA213424-001, ndc-70069-481]

This combines claim 6 and 7. The evidence supports both parts: ob-ANDA215005-001 shows TE code AP, status-ANDA215005 shows at least one package Available. The ndc-70069-481 provides additional package info but not needed. The claim is supported.

All claims appear supported. No factual problems. So unsupported list empty.

I must reply with JSON: {"unsupported":[]}.</think>{"unsupported":[]}
